scope: All 146 full-size/portrait/cast JPEG deliveries; responsive small/preview derivatives checked against existing global provenance. No creative assets changed.
method: Read-only inspection sheets retain each full-size shipped image at native pixel dimensions; labels and padding only. No source or delivered image is modified.
reviewer: AI development visual inspection; user-approved participation proxy
criteria: Visible hands and plausible object grips
Complete framing at native shipped dimensions
No invented receipt, permission, evidence, clearance or resolved outcome
summary: No confirmed structural or continuity defect warranted a repaint in this review. Existing deliveries, meaning, provenance and historical records are retained. Interface caption and layout defects are fixed separately.

limitations: This records AI visual inspection, not independent human/artistic acceptance or proof that every possible defect is absent.
Full-resolution means full-size shipped JPEG deliveries, not the larger generation masters retained outside Git.
Inspection sheets preserve delivery dimensions and add labels/padding; JPEG encoding is inspection-only and changes no shipped file.
Decorative glyphs, barcodes, documents and maps never override canonical text, consent, evidence or item mechanics.
Per-scene art decisions, conditional selectors and all voice bindings remain unchanged; no new scene is introduced.
